cases.label: reorganize
cases.rationale: The tethering purpose remains, but history, progress and orientation move to a separate mother process rather than a lead-managed sequence of steps.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: No evidence that tethering or dogfooding is abandoned.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Managing all the tethering steps ourselves is displaced by a separate mother.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Preserve history, original intent, explorations and reminders while settling how the mother operates.

cases.label: accept
cases.rationale: In-process feed selects an implementation within the continuing Mom design; the evidence does not establish a replacement purpose or a changed scope.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: A new purpose beyond Mom keeping work tethered is unsupported.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: pi-intercom is mentioned as an available idea, not explicitly rejected.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: The subsequent mapping requirement remains to be addressed; feed selection does not discharge it.

cases.label: accept
cases.rationale: The forceful objection reinforces the already stated usage and latency constraint. It asks for better reasoning, without yet selecting a different approach.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: An expensive full-information ingestion mandate is unsupported.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: A design that doubles usage or slows work is challenged, but no particular replacement is settled at the boundary.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Determine how Mom digests enough information cheaply; tether state updates and slim observations remain exploratory here.

cases.label: contract
cases.rationale: The open whole-picture design exploration gains explicit resource limits: avoid doubling model usage and avoid slowing the work. The Mom objective is retained.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Unbounded model consumption is not an authorized means of achieving the Mom design.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: High-overhead approaches are constrained, not every possible mother process.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Return to a viable information-ingestion design within the usage and latency limits; the tether question remains open.

cases.label: contract
cases.rationale: The proposed information stream is narrowed to already-visible observations rather than tool-call content or extra ledger/model calls, with deeper inspection retained on demand and subsequent assent.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Always ingesting full tool content is unsupported by this narrower direction.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Routine extra ledger or model calls are avoided if the slim stream suffices; not an absolute ban on deeper inspection.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Verify that the slim stream is sufficient, retaining Mom’s ability to dig into tool content when needed.

cases.label: redirect
cases.rationale: The user rejects choosing an existing chat client and instead orders a stripped-down Buzz sister project, subsequently named tipsy.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Continuing to recommend existing clients is no longer the requested task.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: The offered existing clients are explicitly rejected.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Build the sister project with the chosen desktop form and initial own-relay scope; retain private kinds.

cases.label: accept
cases.rationale: Keeping Buzz private kinds preserves compatibility in the already requested sister project. The later generic-relay addition is a separate scope change, not this boundary.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Replacing Buzz kinds with generic-only semantics is unsupported.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: No named competing protocol is explicitly rejected; dropping private kinds is inconsistent with the choice.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Continue the simple sister project; subsequent relay testing must retain the chosen kinds.

cases.label: expand
cases.rationale: The instruction broadens a simple non-Buzz relay test into making any relay addable, while expressly retaining Buzz-kind support.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Generic relay support does not authorize dropping Buzz compatibility.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Restricting support to only the original or single test relay is superseded by any-relay addability.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Spin up the chosen nostr-rs-relay and test broader relay support without losing Buzz kinds or simplicity.

cases.label: accept
cases.rationale: Continue, auto-continue and keep going preserve existing work. The sparse evidence supplies no new deliverable or canceled obligation.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: A fresh scope or a completed project cannot be inferred from continue.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: No alternative is rejected in this context.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Resume outstanding work after git initialization and carry it to completion; the meaning of the earlier 1 is not recoverable here.

cases.label: contract
cases.rationale: Keep mentioning but drop management explicitly removes a feature area while preserving the smaller one; later generic assent does not explicitly restore management.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Agent management is no longer supported as current scope.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: The larger management feature is explicitly dropped.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Finish agent mentioning and other unaffected work; all refers to the surviving scope absent an explicit reversal.

cases.label: redirect
cases.rationale: The immediate work changes from overcoming the frozen Reaper/progress problem to fully drafting audit-derived fixes before session end. Later chunking preserves follow-through.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Indefinite live troubleshooting is not the new immediate priority.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Continuing without first preserving the audit fixes is displaced; live work is not permanently banned.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Capture the suggested fixes completely and retain them for chunked follow-through.

cases.label: accept
cases.rationale: The user had already authorized updates; implement the full roadmap confirms that direction. No narrower prior roadmap is shown from which to infer expansion.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Remaining at review-only is unsupported after the existing update authorization.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: A partial roadmap is not explicitly established or rejected in the supplied before evidence.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Complete the full roadmap; the subsequent reminder specifically preserves three open items and all six capabilities.

cases.label: redirect
cases.rationale: The chosen project is challenged as unusable for the requested live slice because samples are missing. The later mounting failure and Live D choice support changing the immediate execution path, not canceling live validation.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: Treating the broken project as ready for the live slice is unsupported.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Unqualified use of that project is rejected; the evidence does not authorize abandoning the live slice.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Resolve or bypass the missing-sample/mount obstacle and return to live testing, with the assistant responsible for loading.

cases.label: redirect
cases.rationale: After the broken-project and mounting obstacles, the user selects Live D now as the actionable next route. This redirects immediate work out of the blocked route without proving the old obstacle was repaired.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: A claim that missing samples or mounting were fixed is unsupported.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: The blocked route is bypassed in favor of Live D; permanent abandonment of its underlying requirements is not evidenced.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Carry out Live D and preserve any unresolved validation requirements; later commit-and-push authorization alone is not proof of their resolution.

cases.label: contract
cases.rationale: The user removes mandatory Sol review after every small chunk, narrowing review overhead rather than eliminating review or reducing the fixes themselves.

criticalObligations.unsupportedCurrentPurpose: A universal no-review policy is unsupported; the exception is conditional on small chunks.
criticalObligations.rejectedAlternative: Review after every small chunk is explicitly no longer required.
criticalObligations.unresolvedReturn: Retain complete audit fixes, chunked progress and appropriate review outside that exception; proceed to the chosen live slice.
